sceneCorrection.title: Scene entry correction (plane frame)
sceneCorrection.legend: Origin = plane centroid; X right, Y up, Z = panel normal toward the camera (10 cm). Orange: offset and the angle between the normal (blue) and the corrected approach (cyan). Rotation applies roll (X), then pitch (Y), then yaw (Z) about the local axes.

subgroupHints.hansenSingle: ARCM with n_hansen = 1 · nn_model selects the segmentor: unet, fpn or yolo26.
subgroupHints.hansenMulti: ARCM with n_hansen > 1, and ALDM multihansen scenery · YOLO only (nn_model must be yolo26).
subgroupHints.yoloShared: Shared by both recognition modes: same values, editing one updates the other.
subgroupHints.poseCommon: Read by every pipeline, ariston_A included.
subgroupHints.hansenPose: Hansen reference cloud and ICP fitness thresholds, used by single and multiple instance recognition (and the ALDM multihansen scenery).

hansen: Hansen is one of the most recognized brands of quick-connect couplings for hydraulic and pneumatic systems.

Its design is so standard within the industry that the term "Hansen-style connector" or "Hansen profile" is often used generically to describe this specific type of coupling, regardless of the manufacturer.

Currently, the Hansen coupling line belongs to Danfoss (following its acquisition of Eaton’s hydraulics division); consequently, it is very common to find these connectors marketed under the names Eaton-Hansen or Danfoss.
